verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Epic serves an llms.txt on both www.unrealengine.com and dev.epicgames.com, giving an AI-native user a real entry point to agent-oriented docs, but the same probe records that identical requests intermittently return WAF 403 challenges instead of the file for non-browser clients (curl/node/python all affected), so an agent cannot reliably fetch it every time. missing for 10: consistent non-browser access without WAF interference, first-party documentation/announcement of the llms.txt surface, and independent third-party confirmation beyond the single probe.
